guides.name: Yuriko the Tiger's Shadow — l4z4i
guides.description:
Билд с Questlog: №1 по популярности у класса (255 лайков), автор l4z4i. Стадий: 10 — выберите целевую.

Описание автора:
Yuriko the Tiger's Shadow
Assassine (Sin) - Global - Season 1

Last Update (06.11): Updated Arcana levels for Endgame and Ultimate builds to more reasonable ones to reach targets, active skills are changed only on one ring. Also Ariel Daevanion boards from Fire Temple and Ferocious Horn Den Hard Mode extended pre-release on 11.11. you need 2800 GS to enter. Renamed Endgame skillset to Farming, created Bossing setup as this was confusing for most and updated PvP setup.

P.S.: Insignia can be well played with -3 CDR and Multi-Hit as stacks are build up fast via HG and SR but still you can try to push to 20 for more DPS but imho not necessary target breakpoint but still can be pushed 6 more levels if you min-max.

Item Upgrades through Campaign Acts 1 to 6 without running Expedition Chests and spending any Odyle Energy
Noble Belt and Revelation Amulet Upgrades through 100% Silent Dungeons plus Strongholds and Substance Morph get Enhancement Materials fast through Daily Dungeon with Instant Tickets

Non-Crafted and Crafted Versions:
Early Endgame 1000-1800 Use Berk Accessories and Bakarma Defensive Equipment or first crafted Star Dragon Lord Items
Mid Endgame 1800-2500+ bolster up with higher Item Levels from Vakron and Uruguru Expedition Bosses or more crafted Defensive Equipment from Star Dragon Lord or on plus Upgrade our existing via Transfer Crafting to Dark Dragon Lord
Late Endgame 2800+ (Ludra Ready) for Kromede and Nuakum Items from Fire Temple and Ferocious Horn Den or C

For PvE Farming in Abyss, take Shadow Walk instead of Savage Fang to disengage when someone attacked us

- Manastone (higher tier = more GS and CP)

- Daevanion (buy all 416)

- Closet (On Main and Alt Buy all non-main char's weapon from Black Cloud Merchant Reset, Savage drops from main+alt, Combine, buy all weapons if have kina to reach 700 skins title, Trade Shop with Alt)

I'm constantly testing and tweaking my build, so keep in mind that things may change over time if you decide to use it.

Skill PrioritiesActive SkillsQuick Slice (20) > Heart Gore (20) > Insignia Explosion (20) >> Storm Rampage (16)
These are the three most important active skills to prioritize. They will be your main sources of damage, while Storm Rampage comes next.
Everything else is significantly less important in terms of damage or is mainly used for mobility.
Passive SkillsRear Smite > Assault Stance > Impact Hit > Exploit Weakness
Prioritize the first three passives and level them up as much as possible. Some Korean players aim for level 35 on these skills.
StigmasEvasion Stance (5) (optional)
Illusive Clone (20) > Swift Contract (20) > Savage Fang (15) > Triniel's Dagger (10)
Staying alive is your highest DPS increase.
If you can't execute the boss perfectly yet, I'd recommend using Evasion Stance for extra survivability.
Since the recent buffs, Illusive Clone and Swift Contract share a cooldown. Even so, I want to emphasize that you should always use these two skills together to get the most out of them.

If you have any feedback, suggestions, or recommendations, feel free to let me know!
I'm always looking for ways to improve the build.
